name: Reed Breunig
why: WKU's own posed headshot of him as an Admissions Ambassador, full face, well lit; the only single-subject portrait of him on a WKU site. The Herald has no photograph of him at all.
quality: 250x315, the size WKU publishes these staff headshots at; not upscaled.

src.label: WKU Office of Admissions, Admissions Ambassadors page (wku.edu), headshot labelled Reed Breunig (file matthew_breunig132.jpg). Cross-checked against the WKU News photograph of the 2022 Coming Home King crowning, captioned "Reed Breunig (center)" (wku.edu/news article 10275): same face. Breunig is an uncommon surname and both pages are WKU records of the same student in the same period.
